Job description:
We at Amn-Afzar company are eager to collaborate with a Python developer to complete our team. Job description: Development, maintenance, and improvement of Python-based services and tools, development and integration of APIs and LLM-based services, design and implementation of REST APIs, and collaboration in developing Back-end services. Collaboration with the technical team in analyzing, developing, and debugging software, code documentation, and adhering to software development standards. Qualifications: Proficiency in the Python programming language, familiarity with Git and version control concepts. Experience or familiarity with LLM APIs (such as OpenAI, Gemini, or similar services). Familiarity with the Linux operating system and basic commands. Familiarity with Back-end concepts including HTTP, REST API, and Client-Server. Ability to learn, problem-solve, and teamwork. Benefits and Opportunities: Competitive salary and benefits, supplementary insurance, job security, internet and free calls (after the trial period), purchase subsidies (via the Oano application), corporate gifts, and financial facilities/loans. On-site corporate physician. Educational and personal development opportunities. Dynamic, friendly work environment, and opportunities for career advancement. Flexible working hours. Work location: Danesh Amooz Street, Mashhad. Amn-Afzar company is growing and developing every day, and here you will have the opportunity to enhance your skills alongside a specialized team and play an effective role in creating innovative solutions.

Company description:
Amn Afzar Gostar Sharif Company was established in the year 1381 and its mission is to conduct research, study, and produce products in the field of ICT in order to safeguard the country's information assets. Since its inception, this company has only expanded its activities in the field of information security, providing valuable knowledge and experience. The result of these efforts is the establishment of fully specialized complexes in the field of information exchange space security along with useful executive and practical records within the framework of Amn Afzar Gostar Sharif Company.
